name: Bees N Blooms
tagline: Bees N Blooms – Sonoma County Flower Farm and Lavender Labyrinth
description: Bees N Blooms is an agritourism farm in 3883 Petaluma Hill Rd, CA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
